title: Blue & Green Bow Dress
description_html:
Embrace the charm of handcrafted fashion with this Blue and Green Bow Dress, a perfect blend of playful details and artisanal craftsmanship. Designed for comfort and elegance, it features a distinctive bow-back design and a mix of vibrant prints that capture the spirit of summer.

Key Highlights

  • Neckline: Oblong square neckline for a modern yet feminine silhouette
     

  • Sleeves: Sleeveless for ease of movement and breezy comfort
     

  • Length: Below-knee length for versatile styling – from casual to dressy
     

  • Back Design: Eye-catching bow detail for a playful, chic finish
     

  • Fabric: Soft and breathable handmade block-printed cotton lurex – lightweight cotton for comfort, with a subtle metallic sheen for sophistication
     

  • Color Palette: Blue and green with a mix of intricate prints, each piece uniquely artisan-made
     

  • Set: Single-piece dress
     

Origin: Proudly Made in India
additional_html:
Care Instructions

  • Gentle machine wash or hand wash
     

  • Use mild detergent
     

  • Do not bleach
     

  • Line dry in shade
     

  • Warm iron on reverse

Styling Tips

  • Pair with nude heels or flats for a polished day look

  • Add silver or oxidized jewelry for an ethnic twist

  • Style with a light scarf or shrug for cooler evenings

title: Blue Lehariya Dress
description_html:
Leheriya Wave Shift Dress
Embrace timeless elegance with our handcrafted Leheriya Wave Shift Dress. Featuring a chic boat neck and sleeveless silhouette, this above-knee dress showcases authentic hand-blocked leheriya wave prints in rich indigo, celebrating traditional artistry.

Crafted from a premium cotton-lurex weave, it offers effortless comfort with a hint of subtle shimmer—perfect for elevating casual outings or summer soirées. Lightweight, breathable, and ethically made, this piece blends heritage charm with contemporary style.
additional_html:
• Fit: Relaxed shift

  • Neckline: Boat neck

  • Length: Above knee

  • Fabric: Cotton-lurex blend (soft, shimmering, non-irritating)

  • Artistry: Hand-block printed waves in indigo

  • Care: Machine wash cold, lay flat to dry

Effortless. Artisanal. Uniquely you. 🌊✨

title: Oblong Neckline Block-Print Dress – Blue & Green
description_html:
Step into effortless style with this Oblong Neckline Block-Print Dress, crafted from breathable cotton-lurex for all-day comfort. Featuring a sleeveless design, artisan prints, and a striking triangle-shaped back detail, this dress blends tradition with modern charm.

Key Highlights

  • Neckline: Oblong neckline for a flattering, elongated look
     

  • Sleeves: Sleeveless for breezy comfort
     

  • Back Design: Elegant triangle cut-out detail
     

  • Length: Knee-length (approximate, varies by size)
     

  • Fabric: Soft and breathable cotton-lurex blend with a subtle sheen
     

  • Print: Handcrafted block prints in blue and green variations
     

  • Set: Single-piece dress
     

Origin: Proudly Made in India
additional_html:
Care Instructions

  • Gentle machine wash or hand wash
     

  • Mild detergent only
     

  • Do not bleach
     

  • Line dry in shade
     

  • Warm iron on reverse
     

Styling Tips

  • Pair with tan flats or neutral sandals for daytime outings
     

  • Add statement jewelry for an elevated evening look
     

  • Works well with a sling bag or tote for casual styling
